name: Anjal API
description:
Anjal is a multi-tenant email API for AI agents.

Create inboxes on the default `@send.anjal.app` domain or your own custom
domains, send and receive mail, manage drafts, subscribe to real-time
events over WebSocket, and isolate resources across workspaces so your
reseller customers can serve their own end-customers under a single
billing relationship.

Install the TypeScript SDK: `npm install anjal`
([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/anjal))

MCP server for Claude Desktop / Cursor: `npx -y anjal-mcp`
([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/anjal-mcp))

## Authentication

Every request is authenticated with the `X-API-Key` header (or
`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Four key prefixes, each with increasing
scope:

| Prefix   | Scope                                   | Use it for                              |
|----------|-----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| `sa_...` | Super admin                             | Tenant lifecycle (platform operator)    |
| `tk_...` | Tenant master                           | Everything in your tenant across workspaces |
| `wk_...` | Workspace master                        | One workspace only                      |
| `ak_...` | Inbox (agent) scoped                    | One inbox — its messages, drafts, lists |

## Resource hierarchy

```
Tenant (billing root)
└── Workspace  (isolation container)
    ├── Inboxes
    │   ├── Messages / Threads / Attachments
    │   ├── Drafts
    │   └── Lists
    └── Domains
```

## Sending mail

Mail is sent via `POST /v1/inboxes/{id}/send`. Replies go through
`/reply/{messageId}`, reply-all through `/reply-all/{messageId}`, and
forwards through `/forward/{messageId}`. The `From` header always uses
the inbox's **primary alias** — add a custom-domain address with
`POST /v1/inboxes/{id}/addresses` to change it.

### Safe retries (Idempotency-Key)

Every send endpoint (`/send`, `/reply`, `/reply-all`, `/forward` and
`POST /v1/inboxes/{id}/drafts/{did}/send`) accepts an `Idempotency-Key`
header. Send a unique value (a UUID works) and retry freely: the first
request sends and stores its response; a retry with the same key and the
identical request returns that stored response with the header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true` and sends nothing.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Same key, different request (body, inbox or endpoint) | `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` |
| Same key while the first request is still running | `409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` |
| Header present but blank, or longer than 255 characters | `400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID` |
| The first send failed (non-2xx) | The key is freed; retry with the same key |

Keys are scoped to your account and expire after 24 hours.

### Labels, open tracking, scheduled send

- **Labels**: pass `labels` (array, or a comma-separated string) on any
  send, reply, reply-all, forward or draft. Change them later with
  `PATCH /v1/inboxes/{id}/messages/{messageId}` or
  `PATCH /v1/inboxes/{id}/threads/{threadId}`, and filter lists with
  `?labels=a,b`. Labels are stored lowercase and deduplicated; at most 32
  per message, each at most 64 characters, no commas.
- **Open tracking**: `trackOpens: true` on a send with an HTML body adds a
  1x1 pixel (the stored copy never contains it). The first open fires
  `message.opened`. Opens are a hint, not proof: Apple Mail Privacy
  Protection fetches images on delivery, and clients that block images
  never report an open.
- **Scheduled send**: set `sendAt` on a draft and Anjal sends it at that
  time. See the Drafts endpoints.
- **Delivery status**: sent messages carry `deliveryStatus`
  (`delivered`, `bounced`, `complained` or `rejected`; null until known)
  and `deliveredAt`.

## Receiving mail

Inbound mail arrives via SMTP on the default domain or any verified
custom domain. Subscribe to delivery events either by registering a
webhook (`POST /v1/webhooks`) or by opening a WebSocket
(`wss://anjal.app/v1/ws`) — useful for in-line 2FA flows where
the agent doesn't have a public webhook receiver.
